BrochureContent.Content: DNG Martin O'Connor Estate Agents are delighted to present to the market Carrowmoreknock, Rosscahill, a charming three-bedroom detached residence enjoying a wonderfully private setting amid beautifully established gardens extending to approximately 0.59 acres.Extending to approximately 127.2 sq.m. (1,369 sq.ft.), the dwelling has an inviting and characterful home where the accommodation and gardens complement one another particularly well. Bright living spaces, a flexible bedroom arrangement and a superb sunroom overlooking the grounds combine with mature planting, traditional stonework and generous lawns to create a property with a distinctive countryside charm.The accommodation on the ground-floor offers a welcoming living room with solid-fuel stove provides a comfortable space to unwind, while the spacious kitchen/dining room forms the practical heart of the home. This is complemented by a separate utility room and a wonderful glazed sunroom, where extensive windows frame views across the gardens and doors open directly outside.Also positioned on the ground floor is one of the property's three bedrooms together with the main bathroom, an arrangement which adds considerable flexibility to the home. Upstairs, there are two further bedrooms and a shower room.Outside the property is where it truly distinguishes itself. The gardens have been carefully established over many years, creating a wonderfully private and colourful setting around the residence. Sweeping lawns are framed by mature trees, shrubs and flowering plants, while traditional stone walls, pathways and natural stone features add texture and character throughout the grounds.There are numerous areas from which to enjoy the gardens, including a decked seating area ideal for outdoor dining and entertaining. A particularly charming feature is the stone-built pizza oven, nestled into the garden setting and creating a fantastic focal point for summer gatherings and evenings outdoors. A garden shed provides useful storage, while the generous lawns offer ample space for recreation, gardening and family life.The property is approached through a traditional gated entrance with a driveway providing generous off-street parking. Mature trees and planting around the site provide an excellent degree of screening and give the proeprty the sense of seclusion and maturity that makes its setting so appealing.For those who enjoy the outdoors, the location offers the added attraction of Knockferry Pier and the shores of Lough Corrib within easy reach, while Collinamuck National School is within walking distance. Moycullen village is approximately a 10-minute drive away, providing an excellent range of supermarkets, shops, cafés, gastropubs, pharmacies, schools, sporting facilities and everyday amenities, with Oughterard and Galway City also readily accessible.With its flexible three-bedroom accommodation, beautiful garden setting and convenient position in the countryside between Moycullen and Oughterard, it is a home of genuine charm and individuality, offering the space and surroundings to enjoy country living while remaining within easy reach of all essential amenities.Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the wonderful setting and character of this delightful property.

Entrance Hall - 
Welcoming entrance into the ground-floor accommodation.

Living Room - 
A warm and inviting reception room with timber flooring and a large window providing excellent natural light. A solid-fuel stove creates an attractive focal point, while the staircase to the first-floor accommodation rises directly from the living room, adding to the cosy character of the space.

Kitchen / Dining Room - 
Bright and spacious kitchen/dining room fitted with a generous range of wall and base units, ample worktop and storage space and tiled flooring. Multiple windows provide excellent natural light, while the adjoining sunroom creates a lovely connection between the main living accommodation and the gardens.

Sunroom - 
A particularly appealing feature of the residence, this bright glazed sunroom enjoys wonderful views across the mature gardens. Extensive glazing allows natural light to flood the room, while French doors provide direct access outside.

Utility Room - 
Practical utility room positioned off the kitchen with fitted storage units, sink, plumbed for a washing machine, tiled flooring and external access.

Bedroom 1 - 
A cosy ground-floor bedroom with timber flooring, built-in storage and fitted bookshelves, complemented by dual-aspect windows providing good natural light.

Bathroom - 
Ground-floor bathroom comprising bath with overhead shower, W.C. and wash-hand basin, with tiled flooring and tiled walls.

Bedroom 2 - 
Bright and well-proportioned bedroom with timber-effect flooring and roof window providing natural light.

Bedroom 3 - 
Comfortable bedroom with timber-effect flooring and roof window.

Shower Room - 
Fitted with a spacious shower enclosure, W.C. and wash-hand basin, with a roof window providing natural light. The shower room benefits from access from both the landing and directly from one of the first-floor bedrooms, creating a convenient Jack-and-Jill style arrangement.

• Charming 3-bedroom detached country residence
  • Extending to approx. 127.2 sq.m. (1,369 sq.ft.)
  • Set on a generous site of approx. 0.59 acres
  • Beautifully established mature and private gardens
  • Flexible layout with ground-floor bedroom and bathroom
  • Superb glazed sunroom overlooking the gardens
  • Attractive stone-built pizza oven and outdoor entertaining area
  • Within walking distance of Collinamuck National School
  • Knockferry Pier and Lough Corrib within easy reach, with Moycullen approx. 10 minutes away
